_comment: Sanitised stand-in so ui/index.html opens in a plain browser with no
toolchain and no real account data. Regenerate a live one with
This deliberately covers every awkward case the panel must survive:
a reading with limit null (no honest denominator, so no bar fill and no
percentage, just the raw amount), a DERIVED percentage that must carry
the tilde marker because its cap came from config rather than the
provider, a provider-reported percentage that must NOT carry it, a
window whose resetsAt is already in the past, a reading above the
critical alert threshold, an envelope warning, and an adapter that
failed. It also carries labels and token counts wide enough to make the
row grid choose between ellipsising the label and clipping the figure.
Timestamps are fixed, so the further past generatedAt you read this, the
more of the resetsAt values fall into the past. That is fine for the
cases above but means the 'resets in' wording eventually stops being
exercised; regenerate the block if you are working on that path.
